items.title: Tony Marino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 25, 2025
items.q: I think you were playing Stevie Wonder’s “Overjoyed.”

ctx.x: And there’s a video of you playing first of all I’m going to take a guess at the song. I don't know if you remember the incident but I think you were playing Stevie Wonder’s “Overjoyed.”
Oh yeah. We played that, but I don’t remember playing that at the Bop Shop.
